name: envUI
description: envUI's design tokens. The base set holds every token with its light, standard-contrast, comfortable value; each modifier context overrides only the tokens it changes. npm run tokens:build turns them into packages/ui/src/styles/Tokens.css and the generated token modules.

base.description: Every token, as the light color scheme at standard contrast and comfortable scale shows it.

colorScheme.description: Light is the base set; dark overrides the colors and state layers it changes. Theme writes the scheme to data-env-theme.

contrast.description: Reserved for the high-contrast themes. Neither context overrides anything yet, so high equals standard and no CSS is built for it.

scale.description: Reserved for the app scale. Neither context overrides anything yet, so compact equals comfortable and no CSS is built for it.
